items.en: Unit-02 EDG room manholes & floor trench covers securely seated

hazards.title: Monitor lizard wandering near CPL colony plant-side gate posing venomous bite risk
hazards.suggestion: Clear wild vegetation along perimeter fencing and apply reptile repellent treatment
hazards.correctiveAction: Clear wild vegetation along perimeter fencing and apply reptile repellent treatment

hazards.title: Uncovered manhole found at Unit-02 near EDG room posing severe fall/fracture risk
hazards.suggestion: Install heavy-duty RCC/checkered steel manhole cover and hard barricade immediately
hazards.correctiveAction: Install heavy-duty RCC/checkered steel manhole cover and hard barricade immediately

hazards.title: Feeding tractor concrete traction slabs loosely held; slab jammed screw feeder & can damage SCC racks/drum extractor shaft
hazards.zone: Fuel & Bagasse Yard (BC-1 to BC-5 / JT)
hazards.suggestion: Securely bolt traction counterweights with steel frame before operating tractor in Bagasse yard
hazards.correctiveAction: Securely bolt traction counterweights with steel frame before operating tractor in Bagasse yard

hazards.title: Monitor #03 and fire hydrant partially covered with soil obstructing emergency access
hazards.zone: Fuel & Bagasse Yard (BC-1 to BC-5 / JT)
hazards.suggestion: Excavate accumulated soil around Fire Monitor #03 and paint safety clearance kerb
hazards.correctiveAction: Excavate accumulated soil around Fire Monitor #03 and paint safety clearance kerb

hazards.title: Air compressor belt fitting too tight at JT#05; burning smell noticed from motor
hazards.zone: Fuel & Bagasse Yard (BC-1 to BC-5 / JT)
hazards.suggestion: Realign compressor pulley and adjust V-belt tension per OEM torque spec
hazards.correctiveAction: Realign compressor pulley and adjust V-belt tension per OEM torque spec

hazards.title: Broken cladding sheet pieces hanging from Close Shed drain channel posing falling object hazard
hazards.zone: Fuel & Bagasse Yard (BC-1 to BC-5 / JT)
hazards.suggestion: Remove hanging GI cladding sheets and re-fasten Close Shed drain channel brackets
hazards.correctiveAction: Remove hanging GI cladding sheets and re-fasten Close Shed drain channel brackets

hazards.title: Exposed edge without side railing or fall protection around Unit 2 CCR HVAC outdoor unit
hazards.suggestion: Install standard 1.1m tubular safety guardrail with toe-board around HVAC platform
hazards.correctiveAction: Install standard 1.1m tubular safety guardrail with toe-board around HVAC platform

hazards.title: Loose exposed electrical wire at bottom of push-button box surrounded by combustible bagasse dust at SCC DE-Side & BC-3
hazards.suggestion: Terminate cable with IP65 explosion-proof cable gland and clear bagasse dust accumulation
hazards.correctiveAction: Terminate cable with IP65 explosion-proof cable gland and clear bagasse dust accumulation

hazards.title: Safety railing pipe damaged and tied with rope at S.B-8 Boiler-1
hazards.suggestion: Weld and restore structural handrail pipe at Soot-Blower #8 elevation platform
hazards.correctiveAction: Weld and restore structural handrail pipe at Soot-Blower #8 elevation platform

hazards.title: Contractor team painting at height on bamboo ladder without fall protection at Maintenance Building
hazards.suggestion: Stop work immediately; enforce certified scaffolding and full-body double-lanyard safety harness
hazards.correctiveAction: Stop work immediately; enforce certified scaffolding and full-body double-lanyard safety harness
